name: Credit Transfer
definition: Payment made by transferring an amount of money from a debtor to a creditor. The payment flows through one or more financial institutions or systems.

StandingOrder.name: Standing Order
StandingOrder.definition: Transaction is a standing order. This information is derived from the presence of detailed standing order specification.

RelatedStandingOrder.name: Related Standing Order
RelatedStandingOrder.definition: Standing order which creates the credit transfers.
